title: [spec-gap][R-05-100/101/102] Density-adaptive announce parameters absent in all stacks (spec 05-routing 9.4)
description: Spec 9.4: Nodes MUST adapt announce parameters based on local density (EstimateDensity from 02a 2a.10.3): interval 300/600/1200/1800s, MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS 15/10/5/3/2, GRADIENT_TIMEOUT 600/1200/2400/3600s; ANNOUNCE_JITTER = INTERVAL/10 capped 120s; re-evaluate at each density update; changes next cycle; MUST NOT abort pending announce. Classification: not-implemented in Rust, C, Python. EstimateDensity exists (rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:124,363) but feeds only SF/duty/CCP-15; C density constants only for SF selection (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.h:194-195); jitter pinned fixed 30s everywhere (rust scheduler.rs:38, python announce/scheduler.py:22, C Kconfig 30000). Python scheduler has _config_changed/_config_revision hooks (scheduler.py:87-88) but no density source wired. Related: project-LICHEN-worker6-xmxi (runtime interval updates do not reach scheduler), b7z9.125 (density beacons - different feature), b7z9.29 (CCP-15 metrics layer). Suggested placement: density-to-announce-param table module per stack, wired from the existing density estimate; vectors for the 5-row table.
